description: This file implements the COSA Data Model Library initialization and cleanup functions, manages telemetry components, and defines related global variables and functions for the plugin.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new COSA backend manager object.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager object, including creating telemetry.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes the backend manager object and associated telemetry.
